description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectActivityDao class within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It contains setup code for initializing test data and multiple test methods that validate the functionality of project activity retrieval, creation, editing, deletion, and duplication behaviors.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDaoTest
classes.description: This class extends TestCase and contains unit tests for the ProjectActivityDao class methods related to project activity management within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of ProjectActivityDao and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of project activities associated with a specific project ID.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityListByFilterProjectActivityName
methods.description: Tests filtering project activities by name within a project.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityById
methods.description: Validates fetching a single project activity by project ID and activity ID.

methods.name: testSaveProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests creating (saving) a new project activity.

methods.name: testEditProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests editing an existing project activity.

methods.name: testExceptionForDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Ensures that deleting a project activity throws a ProjectServiceException when expected.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivity
methods.description: Tests the deletion of a project activity by ID and verifies the result.

methods.name: testDeleteProjectActivityNameValidation
methods.description: Checks whether the project activity name validation correctly identifies taken and available names.

methods.name: testGetDuplicatedActivityIds
methods.description: Tests retrieval of duplicated project activities based on project ID.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivitiesByProjectIds
methods.description: Tests fetching multiple project activities by a list of activity IDs.

methods.name: testSaveCopyActivity
methods.description: Tests copying activities from one project to another and verifies the copied activity.
